title: Where is Foundation's executable?
summary: The framework bundle exists in the FileSystem image, while its executable image is indexed inside the SystemOS dyld shared cache.

title: What is inside the two kernelcaches?
summary: The release and research artifacts share a build but have distinct Mach-O UUIDs. Fileset entries and kext metadata count different structures.

title: Where does SpringBoard's entry point lead?
summary: A stock launchd plist points to a disk executable whose entry thunk imports a SpringBoard.framework function present in the dyld shared cache.

title: Where are SpringBoard's lifecycle entry points?
summary: The intact cache identifies SpringBoard's startup selectors, class relationships, and framework dependencies; function ordering remains to be verified.

title: Why does Foundation reach more images with weak loads?
summary: An exact-cache graph links Foundation to 123 images without weak loads and 1,353 when weak declarations are included.
